model_input.announcement_title: NVIDIA and MediaTek Deepen Long-Standing Partnership to Build AI Edge to Cloud Computing Platforms

evidence.text: NVIDIA and MediaTek Deepen Long-Standing Partnership to Build AI Edge to Cloud Computing Platforms. NVIDIA and MediaTek today announced a deepening of their longstanding collaboration to build the next generations of AI computing platforms — spanning AI infrastructure, local AI computing and automotive.
evidence.title: Official issuer excerpt

evidence.text: NVIDIA and MediaTek today announced a deepening of their longstanding collaboration to build the next generations of AI computing platforms — spanning AI infrastructure, local AI computing and automotive.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 1

evidence.text: As part of the expanded collaboration, MediaTek will adopt the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion™ platform to provide hyperscalers, cloud service providers and frontier model developers with a prevalidated path to develop custom XPUs and bring them into NVIDIA NVLink™-connected, rack-scale AI factories.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 2

evidence.text: The companies combine NVIDIA’s accelerated computing, AI, graphics and software platforms with MediaTek’s leadership in custom silicon, high-performance computing, power-efficient system-on-chip (SoC) design, advanced packaging, interconnects and connectivity.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 3

evidence.text: NVIDIA has also invested $3.5 billion in convertible bonds issued by MediaTek.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 4

evidence.text: NVIDIA and MediaTek are collaborating in three major areas:
evidence.title: Official article · passage 5

evidence.text: AI infrastructure: MediaTek will work with NVIDIA’s NVLink Fusion ecosystem to enable customers to develop custom AI infrastructure designed to integrate with NVIDIA rack-scale systems and AI factories.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 6

evidence.text: Local AI computing: The companies will continue to collaborate on multiple generations of NVIDIA RTX Spark™ and DGX Spark™ PC chips, powering consumer PCs, AI developer supercomputers and enterprise-class workstations, that integrate NVIDIA GPUs with MediaTek SoCs.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 7

evidence.text: Automotive: MediaTek and NVIDIA will continue developing platforms for AI-powered, software-defined vehicles in the era of physical AI.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 8

evidence.text: “AI is transforming every computing platform — from the world’s largest AI factories to the PC and the car,” said Jensen Huang, founder and CEO of NVIDIA. “MediaTek is one of the world’s great semiconductor companies, with exceptional expertise in system-on-chip design, connectivity, leading performance and power efficiency. Together, we’re building platforms that bring NVIDIA accelerated computing to new markets and give customers the freedom to create differentiated AI systems at enormous scale.”
evidence.title: Official article · passage 9

evidence.text: “MediaTek and NVIDIA share a vision for making advanced AI computing pervasive across the technology landscape,” said Rick Tsai, vice chairman and CEO of MediaTek. “NVIDIA’s investment strengthens a collaboration that spans cloud AI infrastructure, local AI computing and automotive in the era of physical AI. By combining NVIDIA’s leadership in accelerated computing and AI software ecosystem with MediaTek’s expertise in a diverse AI technology portfolio from edge to cloud, and our leadership position in custom silicon, we can accelerate innovation for our customers.”
evidence.title: Official article · passage 10

evidence.text: Building Custom AI Infrastructure With NVLink Fusion Platform MediaTek will offer the NVLink Fusion platform as a design foundation for customers developing custom AI accelerators, enabling their platforms to evolve alongside future NVIDIA architectures.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 11

evidence.text: The NVLink Fusion platform provides a prebuilt, prequalified and system-prevalidated foundation for multi-die XPU development — accelerating the path from silicon and advanced packaging to rack-scale systems.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 12

evidence.text: The NVLink Fusion platform brings together the critical technologies surrounding a custom XPU, including:
evidence.title: Official article · passage 13

evidence.text: NVIDIA NVLink Fusion chiplet, connecting XPUs to the NVIDIA NVLink scale-up fabric using NVIDIA photonics or electrical interconnects.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 14

evidence.text: NVIDIA NVLink-C2C, providing high-bandwidth, energy-efficient connectivity between XPUs, NVIDIA Rosa CPUs and other compatible processors.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 15

evidence.text: NVIDIA NVHBM, integrating customized memory capabilities to increase bandwidth and energy efficiency while dedicating more silicon area to compute.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 16

evidence.text: Building a custom accelerator is only the beginning of deploying custom XPUs in rack-scale AI factories. Integrating multi-die architectures, advanced packaging, high-speed SerDes, HBM, I/O and scale-up networking into a manufacturable, production-ready system requires extensive chip-to-rack engineering, qualification and supply-chain support.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 17

evidence.text: Rather than engineering and qualifying every element surrounding a custom XPU from the ground up, customers can focus resources on the differentiated compute that defines their platforms while relying on NVIDIA and MediaTek for the NVLink connectivity, memory architecture, packaging, manufacturing and rack-scale technologies required for production deployment.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 18

evidence.text: Customers can bring their XPU designs to MediaTek and tailor connectivity, memory, packaging, performance and power characteristics to their workloads and infrastructure requirements.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 19

evidence.text: Additionally, MediaTek is part of the broader NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, which enables hyperscalers, cloud service providers and frontier model developers to seamlessly connect custom XPUs to NVIDIA’s AI infrastructure.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 20

evidence.text: With NVLink Fusion, partners can leverage NVIDIA’s proven scale-up and scale-out technology stack and ecosystem, as well as the NVIDIA MGX™ rack-scale architecture, to reduce development complexity, increase performance and accelerate time to market for semi-custom AI factories.
evidence.title: Official article · passage 21

evidence.text: Bringing Supercomputers to Local AI Computing

business_impact.text: NVIDIA and MediaTek have deepened their long-standing partnership to build AI edge-to-cloud computing platforms, which is a significant step in the development of advanced AI infrastructure. This collaboration is expected to accelerate the deployment of custom accelerators and rack-scale systems, enhancing the capabilities of AI factories and cloud service providers. The partnership is likely to have a positive impact on the AI industry by enabling more efficient and scalable solutions.

counterargument.text: While the partnership between NVIDIA and MediaTek is promising, there are potential challenges. The integration of multi-die architectures, advanced packaging, and high-speed SerDes requires extensive engineering and supply-chain support. Additionally, the reliance on NVIDIA and MediaTek for key technologies may limit the flexibility of customers in customizing their solutions. There is also the risk of market saturation and competition from other industry players.
